name: sportsdesk
description: SportsDesk - personal desktop sports, F1 and live TV hub

scripts.format: prettier --write src dev e2e playwright.config.ts index.html vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src dev e2e playwright.config.ts index.html vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig*.json
scripts.test:visual: playwright test e2e/visual.pw.ts e2e/matchAnalysis.pw.ts e2e/tactics.pw.ts e2e/diary.pw.ts e2e/offline.pw.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: playwright test e2e/visual.pw.ts e2e/matchAnalysis.pw.ts e2e/tactics.pw.ts e2e/diary.pw.ts e2e/offline.pw.ts --update-snapshots
